svg.title: Forest Guardian — 21 brass / 7 POM irregular gear variant
svg.desc: 270 by 205 millimeter case, centered 3.4-inch round display, 21 KHK BSS brass gears and 7 DS POM gears in two asymmetrical depth-plane clusters. Same nominal XY centers as the all-POM baseline. Not a fabrication drawing.
svg.text: Irregular XY retained · BSS hubs at catalog diameters · dimensions in mm
gold circle: A front support opening Ø112
blue square: B rear support/display opening 120
blue dashed: display board 115×115 behind the gears
Open upper-right quadrant leaves clear negative space.
Tooth outlines are schematic, not involute
and hubs use catalog diameters. 3D clearance
and board fit remain to be checked.
XY coordinates are relative to the case inside; see the generated axis schedule for case and support-plate datums.
21 brass / 7 POM variant: 3.4-inch IPS, 270×205×145 case, KHK BSS/DS M1 gears, A Ø112 and B 120-square openings.
